abstract: This paper examines the impact of a major geopolitical risk shock, comparable in scale to the outbreak of the Russia–Ukraine war, on household financial distress in five European countries. We combine a VAR, household survey data, and theoretical insights to develop macro–micro simulations that quantify how such shocks influence household balance sheets. The VAR traces the macroeconomic effects of a surge in geopolitical risk, which we apply to household-level data using the HFCS. We find the shock is associated with elevated inflation, tighter monetary policy, higher mortgage rates, and falling house prices. Our simulations show these dynamics significantly increase financial distress, with variation across countries. We incorporate endogenous consumption responses and show that adjustments driven by interest rate exposure, inflation, and housing wealth play a key role in shaping household resilience. We also document that younger and lower-income households tend to increase consumption following the shock, exacerbating their financial vulnerability.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了一次规模可与俄乌战争爆发相媲美的重大地缘政治风险冲击对五个欧洲国家家庭财务困境的影响。我们结合VAR、家庭调查数据和理论洞见，构建宏观—微观模拟，以量化此类冲击如何影响家庭资产负债表。VAR刻画了地缘政治风险骤升的宏观经济效应，我们利用HFCS将其应用于家庭层面数据。我们发现，该冲击与通胀上升、货币政策收紧、抵押贷款利率上升以及房价下跌相关。我们的模拟表明，这些动态显著加剧了财务困境，且在不同国家之间存在差异。我们纳入了内生消费响应，并表明由利率敞口、通胀和住房财富所驱动的调整在塑造家庭韧性方面发挥了关键作用。我们还记录到，年轻家庭和低收入家庭在冲击后倾向于增加消费，从而加剧了其财务脆弱性。
title: Geopolitical shocks and household financial distress in Europe: The Russia–Ukraine war
title_zh: 地缘政治冲击与欧洲家庭财务困境：俄乌战争

abstract: This study measures the extent to which Pigovian transport pricing induces a shift from driving to cycling. In a randomized controlled trial with 1,085 E-bike owners who also drive regularly, we monitor transport choices using a GPS-based tracking app. The pricing intervention reduces transport-related external costs by 7%, mainly in the form of local and national externalities. The underlying mechanism is a mode shift away from driving toward cycling. Estimating a discrete choice model to recover structural preference parameters, we find that a volumetric tax on driving would capture 81% of the intervention's welfare gains.
abstract_zh: 本研究衡量了庇古式交通定价在多大程度上促使人们从驾驶转向骑行。在一项随机对照试验中，我们以1，085名同时经常驾驶的电动自行车车主为对象，使用基于GPS的追踪应用程序监测其交通选择。该定价干预使交通相关外部成本降低了7%，主要表现为地方性和全国性外部性。其内在机制是从驾驶转向骑行的方式转变。通过估计离散选择模型以恢复结构性偏好参数，我们发现，对驾驶征收按量税将获得该干预福利收益的81%。
title: Pricing Cars Off the Road: E-bike Substitution and Welfare Gains from Transport Pricing
title_zh: 让汽车上路成本更高：电动自行车替代与交通定价的福利收益

abstract: We study how politics shapes industrial policy through two paradigmatic twentieth-century cases: the Cassa per il Mezzogiorno in Italy (1950–1984) and Kennedy's Moonshot in the United States (1961–1972). Drawing on historical and primary political sources, we show that each policy originated in a broader political project rather than in an economic diagnosis: the Christian Democrats' pursuit of national integration and democratic consolidation, and Kennedy's New Frontier. We introduce the concept of industrial policy vision - a publicly articulated, transformational objective that political leaders attach to a set of ideals and pursue through state-led intervention in the economy - and develop a five-component definition that makes it empirically tractable. We then trace each vision through decades of newspaper coverage, combining topic modeling and sentiment analysis with systematic close reading. In both cases, public debate proceeded largely within the frame the vision set, granting the policies tolerance for setbacks and expense. The cases diverge in their fates: the Moonshot's bounded vision was redeemed on schedule, while the Cassa's open-ended vision was exhausted by accumulated failure and the policy outlived it only briefly. This divergence points to our central conclusion: while a vision holds, it sets the terms on which an industrial policy's performance is judged, including what counts as failure and how much time the policy is given to deliver.
abstract_zh: 我们通过两个二十世纪的典型案例研究政治如何塑造产业政策：意大利的南方基金局（1950—1984年）与美国的肯尼迪登月计划（1961—1972年）。基于历史资料与一手政治文献，我们表明，这两项政策均源于更广泛的政治工程，而非经济诊断：基督教民主党追求国家整合与民主巩固，以及肯尼迪的新边疆。我们引入“产业政策愿景”这一概念——即政治领袖将其附着于一套理想之上、并通过国家主导的经济干预加以追求的、公开阐述的转型性目标——并发展出一个包含五个组成部分的定义，使其在经验上可操作。随后，我们通过数十年间的报纸报道追踪每一种愿景，将主题建模与情感分析同系统的细读相结合。在两种情况下，公共辩论基本上都在愿景所设定的框架内展开，从而赋予这些政策对挫折与开支的容忍。两个案例的命运出现分化：登月计划有边界的愿景如期得到兑现，而南方基金局开放式的愿景则因不断累积的失败而耗尽，政策在其之后仅短暂存续。这一分化指向我们的核心结论：只要一种愿景仍然成立，它就设定了评判一项产业政策表现的条件，包括什么算作失败，以及该政策被给予多少时间来实现目标。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为意大利南部开发基金和美国肯尼迪登月计划，不涉及中国、中国企业、中国人群、中国地区、香港或台湾。
title: The Political Foundations of Industrial Policy: Emergence, Endurance, and Exhaustion
title_zh: 产业政策的政治基础：兴起、持续与衰竭

abstract: The Northern Territory (NT) of Australia faces unique social, political, economic, and geographical food security challenges for Aboriginal Communities. International research and policy have advocated for greater coherence across government policies that support Indigenous-grounded perspectives on food security. While the need for cross-government collaboration to support community food security is recognised in national policies, implementation requires practical guidance, with an examination of opportunities to strengthen cross-sectoral policies. This policy analysis explores how NT Government public policies can be strengthened to better reflect remote Aboriginal food security, drawing on an adapted six-dimension food security framework (availability, access, utilisation, stability, sustainability, agency). Five key NT government departments were assessed. Most dimensions were partially represented by all departments. Stability was least represented, which is concerning considering volatile NT weather and global financial markets. Indigenous self-determination is relevant to all food security dimensions; some departments had limited examples of its implementation. Departments’ objectives need coherence and greater attention to food stability and availability. Greater policy coherence could strengthen food security, particularly for Indigenous Peoples and in jurisdictions with high food insecurity.
abstract_zh: 澳大利亚北领地（NT）的原住民社区面临着独特的社会、政治、经济和地理层面的粮食安全挑战。国际研究和政策倡导加强政府政策之间的一致性，以支持植根于原住民视角的粮食安全观。尽管国家政策已认识到需要跨政府合作以支持社区粮食安全，但政策实施需要实践指导，并需审视加强跨部门政策的机会。本政策分析探讨了如何强化北领地政府的公共政策，以更好地反映偏远原住民的粮食安全状况，分析借鉴了一个经过调整的六维度粮食安全框架（可获得性、可及性、利用、稳定性、可持续性、能动性）。研究评估了北领地政府的五个关键部门。大多数维度在所有部门中均得到部分体现。稳定性维度的体现最为不足，鉴于北领地天气和全球金融市场的波动性，这一发现令人担忧。原住民自决与所有粮食安全维度均相关；部分部门在落实自决方面的实例有限。各部门的目标需要加强一致性，并更加关注粮食稳定性和可获得性。增强政策一致性可以强化粮食安全，尤其是对原住民而言，以及在粮食不安全程度较高的管辖区域。
title: Strengthening Indigenous food security in remote Northern Australia: A policy analysis
title_zh: 加强澳大利亚北部偏远地区原住民粮食安全：政策分析

abstract: This study examines gender differences in the returns to schooling across industries in the United States before, during, and after the COVID-19 pandemic. Using data from the American Community Survey (ACS) for 2010–2024, our findings indicate that returns to schooling declined for both men and women during the pandemic and recovered only partially during the post-COVID period. Overall, women continued to experience slightly higher average returns to schooling than men, although the female advantage narrowed during the post-COVID period. Significant heterogeneity exists across industries: while some sectors, including Mining and Utilities, exhibited higher relative returns to schooling for women, others, such as Educational Services, Administrative Services, and Health Care, experienced reductions in the female advantage. Additional analysis of wage changes by education level indicates that less-educated workers generally experienced faster wage growth than college-educated workers during the pandemic, contributing to a decline in the educational wage premium. These findings highlight the importance of considering industry-specific labour market conditions when evaluating gender differences in the economic returns to education. KEYWORDS: Returns to schooling gender differences COVID-19 industry effects wage differential JEL CLASSIFICATION: J24 J31
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了新冠疫情前、疫情期间及疫情后美国各行业中教育回报的性别差异。基于2010—2024年美国社区调查（ACS）数据，我们的研究发现表明，疫情期间男性和女性的教育回报均有所下降，且在疫情后时期仅部分回升。总体而言，女性的平均教育回报仍略高于男性，但这一女性优势在疫情后时期有所收窄。各行业之间存在显著异质性：一些部门（包括采矿和公用事业）中女性的相对教育回报较高，而其他部门（如教育服务、行政服务和医疗保健）中女性的优势则有所下降。进一步按教育水平分析工资变化表明，疫情期间受教育程度较低的工人工资增长通常快于受过大学教育的工人，从而导致教育工资溢价下降。这些发现凸显了在评估教育经济回报的性别差异时，考虑行业特定劳动力市场状况的重要性。关键词：教育回报 性别差异 新冠疫情 行业效应 工资差异 JEL分类：J24 J31
title: The Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on gender differences in the returns to schooling: an industry-level perspective
title_zh: 新冠疫情对教育回报性别差异的影响：基于行业层面的视角

abstract: Climate change has become an increasingly important source of financial risk, attracting growing interest in how carbon emissions are priced in equity markets. Although the literature is expanding, firm-level evidence from emerging markets remains limited. In this paper, we examine whether corporate carbon emissions intensity predicts future idiosyncratic stock return volatility among Indian listed firms over the period 2009–2023. We find that firms with higher CO2 emissions intensity, measured as Scope 1 and Scope 2 carbon-dioxide-equivalent (CO2e) emissions scaled by revenue, exhibit significantly higher one-period-ahead idiosyncratic stock return volatility. Specifically, a one-standard-deviation increase in emissions intensity increases annualised idiosyncratic volatility by 1.32 percentage points, representing 4.6% of the sample mean. The relationship is driven primarily by direct (Scope 1) rather than purchased energy (Scope 2) emissions and is stronger for firms covered by India’s Perform, Achieve and Trade (PAT) scheme and during periods of elevated economic policy uncertainty, but weaker for firms that use renewable energy. We also find evidence that stock illiquidity is a potential channel through which carbon emissions influence future firm-specific stock return risk. The results remain robust to alternative measures of emissions intensity and risk, sample-selection corrections, a lead test, an instrumental-variables analysis, and additional robustness checks. Overall, our findings suggest that firm-level carbon emissions are an important determinant of firm-specific stock return risk in an emerging equity market.
abstract_zh: 气候变化已成为日益重要的金融风险来源，引发了学界对碳排放如何在股票市场中被定价的关注。尽管相关文献不断扩展，但来自新兴市场的企业层面证据仍然有限。本文考察在2009—2023年期间，企业碳排放强度是否能够预测印度上市公司的未来特质性股票收益波动率。我们发现，二氧化碳排放强度较高的企业——以范围1和范围2二氧化碳当量（CO2e）排放量除以营业收入衡量——表现出显著更高的下一期特质性股票收益波动率。具体而言，排放强度每增加一个标准差，年化特质性波动率上升1.32个百分点，相当于样本均值的4.6%。这一关系主要由直接排放（范围1）而非外购能源排放（范围2）驱动，并且在受印度“绩效、实现与交易”（PAT）计划覆盖的企业以及经济政策不确定性较高时期更强，但在使用可再生能源的企业中较弱。我们还发现，股票流动性不足是碳排放影响未来企业特定股票收益风险的潜在渠道。在采用替代性排放强度与风险衡量指标、样本选择校正、领先项检验、工具变量分析以及额外稳健性检验后，结果依然稳健。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，在新兴股票市场中，企业层面碳排放是企业特定股票收益风险的重要决定因素。
title: Carbon emissions intensity and idiosyncratic volatility: Evidence from Indian firms
title_zh: 碳排放强度与特质波动率：来自印度企业的证据

abstract: Using China's Growth Enterprise Market (GEM) registration reform as a quasi-natural experiment, this study examines how secondary-market institutional changes improve listed firms' information disclosure through institutional investors. The reform activates both "voice" and "exit" mechanisms. However, in emerging markets with high agency costs, weak legal institutions, and high volatility, active monitoring remains shallow, making "exit" the dominant channel—mainly enhancing accounting disclosure. For narrative disclosure, institutional investors' governance is weak, likely due to short-term investors' limited attention and long-term investors' constrained supervision. Heterogeneity analyses indicate that accounting disclosure improves more in firms with low agency costs, sound legal environments, and high market volatility, whereas narrative disclosure improvement is not significantly moderated by these factors. This study provides new insights into the micro-transmission mechanisms of institutional reforms and suggests that, alongside market discipline, policies should refine disclosure guidelines and reinforce board engagement to better guide voluntary disclosure.
abstract_zh: 本文以中国创业板注册制改革为准自然实验，考察二级市场制度变革如何通过机构投资者改善上市公司信息披露。该改革同时激活了“发声”与“退出”两种机制。然而，在代理成本高、法律制度薄弱且波动性高的新兴市场中，积极监督仍流于表面，使得“退出”成为主导渠道——主要提升了会计信息披露。对于叙述性披露，机构投资者的治理作用较弱，可能源于短期投资者注意力有限以及长期投资者监督受限。异质性分析表明，会计信息披露在代理成本低、法律环境健全且市场波动性高的公司中改善更为明显，而叙述性披露的改善并未受到这些因素的显著调节。本研究为制度改革的微观传导机制提供了新见解，并建议在依靠市场约束的同时，政策应完善披露指引并强化董事会参与，以更好地引导自愿性披露。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: When Exit Prevails: The Asymmetric Governance of Information Disclosure and the Plight of Soft Information
title_zh: 当退出占优：信息披露的非对称治理与软信息困境

abstract: This note tests whether displayed liquidity deteriorates before scheduled macroeconomic announcements. Using millisecond-level E-mini S&P 500 futures order-book data at 78 announcement times in 2024, we find that spreads widen by 5.3% and best-quote depth falls by 8.7% in the final ten seconds before release, relative to minutes 1–10 before release. These changes persist locally and are not mirrored in 58 matched pseudo-windows without material scheduled releases. During the first ten seconds after release, message-sequence classification assigns 31.2% of absolute midquote adjustment to execution-driven depletion and 64.0% to cancellation-driven depletion and explicit non-trade quote updates. The findings are consistent with anticipatory liquidity withdrawal.
abstract_zh: 本文检验了在预定宏观经济公告发布前，显示流动性是否会恶化。利用2024年78个公告时点的毫秒级E-mini标普500期货订单簿数据，我们发现，相对于发布前第1至第10分钟，发布前最后十秒内买卖价差扩大5.3%，最优报价深度下降8.7%。这些变化在局部持续存在，并且在58个无重大预定发布的匹配伪窗口中并未出现。在发布后最初十秒内，消息序列分类将31.2%的绝对中间价调整归因于执行驱动的流动性消耗，将64.0%归因于取消驱动的流动性消耗和明确的非交易报价更新。这些发现与预期性流动性撤出相一致。
title: Liquidity withdrawal before scheduled macroeconomic announcements
title_zh: 预定宏观经济公告前的流动性撤回

abstract: To explore a broader dimension of board gender diversification, we investigate whether increased gender-equal government policy in relation to shared parental leave (SPL) affects the governance behavior of male board directors. We analyze the influence of the 2015 UK SPL policy using data on 1930 UK firms and semi-structured interviews with board directors. Consistent with social influence theory, we observe changes in male directors’ governance decisions after SPL. Attributable to better corporate governance, financial performance improves in firms with predominantly male boards. Director interviews reveal increased board level focus on gender equality and SPL, often facilitated by considerate, yet powerful, male directors. Broadening research on corporate governance and gender, our study suggests the positive influence of increased commitment to gender equality on the corporate governance behavior of the predominant cohort of male directors. For board gender diversity to contribute to meaningful performance improvements diversity must be embedded at deep organizational levels, and women directors must be granted sufficient power to effect strategic change. Governments need to ensure gender egalitarian policies foster structural equality and encourage fathers to take parental leave. In addition to focusing on gender representation targets, firms must address boardroom gender power imbalance.
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 250
title: Shared parental leave, male board directors, and firm performance: A corporate governance perspective
title_zh: 共享育儿假、男性董事与企业绩效：公司治理视角

abstract: International war crimes trials have become a common feature of post–civil war politics, sparking debate about the effectiveness of such interventions. A key shortcoming in the literature is its neglect of the critical moment when wartime leaders are arrested and that such incarcerations sometimes trigger public resistance that can put peace at risk. In this paper, we contribute to the literature on war crime tribunals by asking: when and how do subelites mobilize followers to protest the arrest of former wartime leaders? Drawing on insights from the protest movement literature, we hold that large-scale protests often require elite involvement. We argue that demonstrations are especially likely when subelites possess limited autonomy in the aftermath of war—lacking independent sources of financing and constrained by identity politics. In such contexts, the cost of remaining passive is high, compelling subelites to mobilize protests to maintain their standing among followers. To assess this argument, we compare the incarcerations of Jean-Pierre Bemba in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Charles Taylor in Liberia. Our analysis draws on original, in-depth interviews with key informants in both countries. The paper contributes by unpacking the conditions under which local actors contest international criminal justice interventions.
title: Arrested development: analyzing popular resistance against the arrest of war-criminals in DR Congo and Liberia
title_zh: 发展受阻：分析刚果民主共和国和利比里亚对逮捕战争罪犯的民众抵抗

abstract: Few features of modern work are as widely criticised as meetings. Using data from over 9,000 workers in Norway, this column examines how meetings are organised and their effects on firm outcomes. The average worker in our survey spends 4.7 hours per week in meetings, with managers and professionals spending substantially more time in them than other workers. Meetings are substantially more common at firms with higher wage premia and higher revenue, while workers who spend more time in meetings experience faster wage growth, suggesting that meetings provide opportunities to exchange information and knowledge that may benefit not only the firm, but also the workers who participate in them.
abstract_zh: 现代工作中，很少有哪个环节像会议这样广受诟病。本文利用来自挪威9000多名员工的数据，考察会议是如何组织的，以及会议对企业产出的影响。在我们的调查中，普通员工每周花在会议上的时间为4.7小时，而管理者和专业人士花在会议上的时间远多于其他员工。在工资溢价更高、收入更高的企业中，会议明显更为普遍；同时，花更多时间开会的员工工资增长更快，这表明会议提供了交流信息和知识的机会，这不仅可能使企业受益，也可能使参与会议的员工受益。
authors: David Deming, Katrine Løken, Alexander Willén, Yaling Xu
title: Why we spend so much time in meetings
title_zh: 我们为何在会议上花费如此多时间

abstract: Does the price of synthetic dollar funding depend on which dealer intermediates the trade? We answer this question by comparing FX forwards in the same dollar currency pair, half-hour, and maturity bucket, which removes the common forward curve and isolates dealer-specific pricing. These dealer-specific prices vary substantially: their standard deviation is about 4 basis points per year, and the large dispersion is present both across dealers at a point in time and over time for a given dealer. Dealers charge 2.5 basis points more for buying dollars forward than for selling them, and the gap widens to 11.8 basis points at maturities under one month. The asymmetry survives controls for client-dealer relationships and trade characteristics. Differences in funding costs account for little of the observed price dispersion. Synthetic dollar funding therefore has many prices, reflecting dealer clientele and pricing power more than underlying funding conditions.
abstract_zh: 合成美元融资的价格是否取决于哪家交易商充当中介？我们通过比较同一美元货币对、同一半小时区间和同一期限分档中的外汇远期来回答这一问题，从而剔除共同的远期曲线并分离出交易商特定的定价。这些交易商特定价格差异显著：其标准差约为每年4个基点，而且这种大幅离散既存在于某一时点不同交易商之间，也存在于同一交易商的不同时间之间。交易商在买入美元远期时比卖出美元远期多收取2.5个基点，而在期限不足一个月时，这一差距扩大至11.8个基点。该不对称性在控制客户—交易商关系和交易特征后依然存在。融资成本差异只能解释观察到的价格离散中的很小一部分。因此，合成美元融资存在许多价格，这更多反映的是交易商客户群和定价能力，而非基础融资状况。
title: One dollar, many prices: dealer-specific pricing of synthetic dollar funding
title_zh: 一美元，多种价格：合成美元融资的交易商特定定价

abstract: The distribution of parental leave uptake and childcare activities continues to conform to traditional gender roles. In 2002, with the goal of increasing gender equality, Sweden added a second “daddy month,” i.e., an additional month of pay-related parental leave reserved exclusively for each parent. This policy increased men’s parental leave uptake and decreased women’s, thereby increasing men’s share. To understand how various factors contributed to these outcomes, we develop and estimate a quantitative model of the household in which preferences towards parental leave respond to peer behavior. We distinguish households by the education of the parents and ask the model to match key features of the parental leave distribution before and after the reform by gender and household type (the parents’ education). We find that changed incentives and, especially, changed social norms played an important role in generating these outcomes whereas changed wage parameters, including the future wage penalty associated with different lengths of parental leave uptake, were minor contributors. We then use our model to evaluate three counterfactual policies designed to increase men’s share of parental leave and conclude that giving each parent a non-transferable endowment of parental leave or only paying for the length of time equally taken by each parent would both dramatically increase men’s share whereas decreasing childcare costs has almost no effect.
title: Parental Leave: Economic Incentives and Cultural Change
title_zh: 育儿假：经济激励与文化变迁

abstract: We field a series of experiments in a population-representative survey of European consumers to examine their attitudes towards the possible introduction of a digital euro. First, we show that a short video explaining the key features of the digital euro is effective in changing consumers’ beliefs about such a new form of payment and increases the likelihood of adoption by 12pp relative to a control group that is not shown the video. Second, we find that on aggregate consumers would allocate a relatively small fraction from a positive wealth shock to digital euros and their allocation to other liquid assets would be little affected. Third, holding limits in the range of €1,000 to €10,000 have insignificant differential effects on the composition of liquid asset holdings. We also show that a non-trivial fraction of consumers report that they will not adopt the digital euro due to strong preferences for existing forms of payment.
title: Consumer Attitudes towards a Central Bank Digital Currency
title_zh: 消费者对中央银行数字货币的态度

abstract: We develop a Schumpeterian growth model in which limited commitment in debt markets gives rise to a soft budget constraint syndrome. Because financiers cannot commit not to refinance underperforming innovators, funding may be misallocated. Tighter financial conditions reallocate resources toward entry but reduce incumbent innovation, generating a hump-shaped relationship between refinancing costs and growth. We characterize the optimal refinancing policy and show that it depends critically on the elasticity of entry. Calibrating the model to French firm-level data, we find that the optimal response to a refinancing cost shock is to ease refinancing conditions, preserving incumbent innovation at the expense of lower entry and substantially mitigating the resulting growth and welfare losses.
title: Firm Dynamics and Growth with Soft Budget Constraints
title_zh: 软预算约束下的企业动态与增长

abstract: We use zip code-level Statistics of Income data from the Internal Revenue Service to measure the distribution of income within U.S. metropolitan areas from 1998 through 2019. Exploiting geographic variation in income distribution over time, we study how unanticipated changes in the monetary policy stance shape the subsequent dynamics of income inequality. The results indicate that monetary policy persistently affects labor income inequality and that these distributional effects are amplified significantly in weak local labor markets.
title: Monetary Policy and the Distribution of Income: Evidence from U.S. Metropolitan Areas
title_zh: 货币政策与收入分配：来自美国大都市区的证据

abstract: This paper examines how leadership changes affect local bureaucratic performance. Combining personnel and citizen surveys with a regression discontinuity design in a large sample of Indonesian villages, we show that electoral turnover revitalizes local bureaucracies and improves the flow of information about citizen preferences. Bureaucrats serving new leaders interact more with citizens and are less connected to past or present village officials, resulting in a more responsive village government that better incorporates citizens' demands in policy-making. This improves local service provision, as measured in both administrative data and citizen surveys. Overall, our findings suggest that leadership turnover can mitigate elite capture and improve governance in local administrations.
title: It Takes a Village Election: Turnover and Performance in Local Bureaucracies
title_zh: 村庄选举的力量：地方官僚机构的人员更替与绩效

abstract: We study a small open economy that must implement an emissions reduction plan and eventually phase out fossil fuel. R&D leads to the design of energy saving new machines. Endogenous scrapping eliminates old inefficient machines. We identify two distortions that delay the adoption and diffusion of energy saving technology: scrapping of old equipment and investment in new machines are both too low. The optimal policy to manage the energy transition thus combines a carbon tax with a profit tax to speed up exit, and an investment subsidy to speed up investment in new equipment. The optimal policy increases capital turnover, the diffusion of energy saving technology, and thereby mitigates the costs of the energy transition. Compared to a policy that exclusively relies on carbon taxes, the optimal policy could reduce the GDP loss of moving to net zero from 7.8 to 6.1% of GDP.
title: Energy Saving Innovation, Vintage Capital, and the Green Transition
title_zh: 节能创新、 vintage 资本与绿色转型

abstract: Under the dual pressures of rapid urbanization and climate change, cropland systems in China are facing escalating degradation risks, posing a critical threat to national food security. However, the compound driving mechanisms and nonlinear threshold effects underlying cropland degradation remain insufficiently understood, particularly across the contrasting contexts of southern and northern China. Therefore, this study constructed a multidimensional cropland degradation index and integrated interpretable machine learning (XGBoost–SHAP) with Generalized Additive Model (GAM) to identify dominant drivers and nonlinear thresholds from 2000 to 2020. Results indicated that, although cropland degradation in China generally followed a fluctuating mitigation trend, degradation levels remained consistently higher in the south (0.435) than in the north (0.398). Socioeconomic pressures dominated cropland degradation in southern China, whereas climatic stressors were more influential in northern China. Slope, temperature, and population density emerged as the primary drivers of cropland degradation at the nationwide, northern, and southern levels, respectively. At the county level, dominant drivers displayed marked spatial heterogeneity characterized by both longitudinal zonation and terrain dependence. GAM results further revealed complex nonlinear responses of cropland degradation to major drivers, with clear sensitivity intervals and time-varying thresholds. These thresholds differed substantially between southern and northern China. At the national scale, the cropland degradation index reached its peak at a population density of 75 persons/km², a temperature of 20°C, and a slope of 8°. Meanwhile, degradation risk shifted progressively from steep to moderate slopes and from sparsely populated to more densely populated areas. These findings provide a scientific basis for threshold-based early warning and regionally differentiated cropland protection policies, thereby supporting land degradation neutrality and sustainable development.
abstract_zh: 在快速城市化与气候变化的双重压力下，中国耕地系统面临日益加剧的退化风险，对国家粮食安全构成严重威胁。然而，耕地退化背后的复合驱动机制与非线性阈值效应仍缺乏充分认识，尤其是在中国南方与北方迥异情境下的对比研究尚不充分。为此，本研究构建了多维耕地退化指数，并融合可解释机器学习（XGBoost–SHAP）与广义相加模型（GAM），以识别2000—2020年间的 dominant 驱动因子与非线性阈值。结果表明，尽管中国耕地退化总体呈波动缓解趋势，但南方退化水平（0.435）始终高于北方（0.398）。南方耕地退化以社会经济压力为主导，而北方则受气候胁迫因子影响更为显著。在全国、北方和南方尺度上，坡度、温度和人口密度分别成为耕地退化的首要驱动因子。在县域尺度上，主导驱动因子呈现显著的空间异质性，表现为经向分带与地形依赖并存的特征。GAM结果进一步揭示了耕地退化对主要驱动因子的复杂非线性响应，具有明显的敏感区间和时变阈值。这些阈值在南方与北方之间差异显著。在全国尺度上，耕地退化指数在人口密度为75人/km²、温度为20°C、坡度为8°时达到峰值。同时，退化风险逐步从陡坡向缓坡、从人口稀疏区向人口较密集区转移。这些发现为基于阈值的预警和区域差异化耕地保护政策提供了科学依据，从而支撑土地退化零增长与可持续发展。

title: Machine learning reveals divergent drivers and migrating thresholds of cropland degradation in Southern and Northern China
title_zh: 机器学习揭示中国南北方耕地退化的差异化驱动因素与迁移阈值

abstract: A Just Transition, with its dual goals of environmental sustainability and social equity, has gained global prominence and has been adopted as a formal policy agenda by governments and intergovernmental organizations. While broad and meaningful public support for both goals is crucial to effective implementation, research on public attitudes has largely focused on developed Western countries or specific vulnerable populations. To address this gap, we examine whether and how support for environmental protection aligns or conflicts with backing for progressive redistribution across a diverse range of developed and developing countries. We posit that access to economic safety nets enables broader alignment at the population level (i.e., breadth of support), while post-materialist values and lived endorsement of the welfare state foster stronger individual-level alignment (i.e., depth of support). Our analysis, covering 95 countries from 2005 to 2022, finds support for these expectations. First, the population share of Green-Blue progressives supporting both goals is notably smaller in developing countries with high economic insecurity. Second, one’s environmental and redistributive attitudes in much of the Global South are unaligned or negatively correlated, in contrast to the positive individual-level alignment observed in developed countries, particularly among post-materialists and in generous welfare states. Regional variation is also significant: Europe ranks high in breadth and shows significant depth; North America shows strong depth but no significant breadth; East Asia demonstrates wide breadth but comparatively shallow depth. Sub-Saharan Africa lags significantly on both dimensions. This global variation calls for context-sensitive Just Transition policies that account for distinct socioeconomic realities.
abstract_zh: 公正转型兼具环境可持续性与社会公平的双重目标，已在全球范围内获得显著关注，并被各国政府和政府间组织采纳为正式政策议程。尽管公众对这两项目标的广泛而实质性的支持对于有效实施至关重要，但关于公众态度的研究在很大程度上集中于西方发达国家或特定弱势群体。为填补这一空白，我们考察在多个发达与发展中国家中，对环境保护的支持与对进步性再分配的支持之间是否以及如何一致或冲突。我们假设，经济安全网的可得性能够在人口层面促成更广泛的一致性（即支持的广度），而后物质主义价值观和对福利国家的切身认同则促进更强的个体层面一致性（即支持的深度）。我们的分析涵盖2005年至2022年的95个国家，结果支持了这些预期。第一，在经济不安全感较高的发展中国家，同时支持两项目标的“绿蓝进步派”人口比例明显较小。第二，在全球南方许多地区，个人的环境态度与再分配态度并不一致或呈负相关，这与发达国家观察到的个体层面正相关形成对比，尤其是在后物质主义者群体和福利慷慨的国家中。区域差异也十分显著：欧洲在广度上排名较高，并表现出显著的深度；北美表现出较强的深度，但广度不显著；东亚展现出广泛的广度，但深度相对较浅。撒哈拉以南非洲在两个维度上均明显落后。这种全球差异要求制定情境敏感的公正转型政策，以考虑不同的社会经济现实。
title: Are the blue and the green natural allies? Mapping the public foundations of just transition worldwide
title_zh: 蓝色与绿色是天然盟友吗？绘制全球公正转型的公众基础

abstract: This paper investigates the role of rights offerings in U.S. Chapter 11 reorganizations as a new market-based mechanism for mitigating bargaining frictions. Using novel hand-collected data, I document three facts: (i) over the past two decades, rights offerings financed 35% of large bankruptcies, (ii) they are predominantly proposed and underwritten by hedge funds, and (iii) their occurrence is highly correlated with stock market performance. In an instrumental variable setting, I find that compared with other sources of financing, rights offerings lead to higher creditor recoveries, shorter reorganization durations, and lower refiling rates. They also allow firms to access new capital without resorting to asset liquidations, which are value-reducing. My findings suggest that by alleviating key bargaining frictions in large and complex bankruptcy cases, rights offerings may improve the efficiency of resource allocation in the economy.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国第11章重整程序中配股作为一种缓解谈判摩擦的新型市场化机制所发挥的作用。基于新颖的手工收集数据，我记录了三个事实：（i）过去二十年中，配股为35%的大型破产案件提供了融资；（ii）配股主要由对冲基金提出并承销；（iii）配股的发生与股票市场表现高度相关。在工具变量设定下，我发现与其他融资来源相比，配股带来更高的债权人回收率、更短的重整期限以及更低的再次申请破产率。配股还使企业能够在不诉诸资产清算的情况下获得新资本，而资产清算会降低价值。我的研究结果表明，通过缓解大型复杂破产案件中的关键谈判摩擦，配股可能改善经济中资源配置的效率。
title: Do rights offerings reduce bargaining complexity in Chapter 11?
title_zh: 配股是否降低了第11章破产中的谈判复杂性？

abstract: A variety of timing strategies shown to generate alpha and high Sharpe ratios at the monthly horizon exhibit substantially deteriorated performance at longer investment horizons. The effect is large: multi-factor alphas are more than halved going from one-month to 10-year returns, and factors that exploit time-series predictability drive them to zero. I argue that such return dynamics reflect compensation for exposure to shocks that are particularly risky from a long-horizon investor’s perspective. I illustrate the idea by showing that seasonality in the volatility of price-of-risk and expected-cash-flow shocks generates seemingly profitable timing strategies.
abstract_zh: 多种择时策略在月度期限上表现出能够产生阿尔法和高夏普比率，但在更长的投资期限上，其表现则显著恶化。这一效应相当大：从一个月期到10年期回报，多因子阿尔法减少了一半以上，而利用时间序列可预测性的因子则将其降至零。我认为，这种回报动态反映了对长期投资者而言尤其危险的冲击暴露所获得的补偿。我通过展示风险价格波动性和预期现金流冲击中的季节性如何生成看似有利可图的择时策略，来说明这一观点。
title: Discounting timing strategies
title_zh: 折现时机策略
